That triggers our vendor verification step.

Two practical paths to keep the PO pipeline moving:
1) Short-term provisional PO (Net 30) — procurement can issue a provisional PO for initial services up to $12k while legal/finance resolves the identity chain. This requires: a signed vendor declaration (one-paragraph) and a scanned bank letter showing account ownership.
2) Strong evidence route — a bank letter or notarized apostille showing legal name + EIN/TIN alignment; this is preferred for full vendor activation.

Ben — can you confirm if procurement can approve a provisional PO and cap? Monica — please confirm what minimal vendor declaration wording we accept. I can share a sample bank-letter template (attached) and a DocuSign envelope if NordicCloud prefers e-sign + video liveness.

Our priority is avoiding a hard hold while keeping audit controls intact. If you can do a tele-notary today, that would be fastest. Otherwise the provisional PO will get you into the system for the first invoice.

Thanks,
